local_policies: Veranus freezes the full active living enemy physical minion group, then uses existing captured Health setter. Dormant/non-minion objects excluded; existing Health setter/lifecycle determines resulting current/max Health and later stale skips.

Frizz queries all physical own-deck minions using current Dragon/all tribes; each original stored reference receives ordinary permanent delta-2 cost with normal zero floor. Repeats re-query the then-current complete deck.

Therazane snapshots current Elemental/all physical hand/deck references and current Attack/max Health, then ordinary stored relative buffs double those values without new cost/keyword/tribe writers. Repeated actual Deathrattles each double the updated current state. Current tribe exclusions and stale lifetimes use original shared policies.

Eysor actual own end turn uses existing all-zone current Totem/all group, excludes only the original physical source and applies ordinary+1/+1. Other copies are not excluded by card ID; active living board and stored hand/deck policies retain original scope.

Aya both real Battlecry and Deathrattle use CLASSIC existing four-template Jade family. One original logical growth attempt advances shared player history, full-board attempts still advance, and original first delivery identity binds to its reserved attributed summon root.

Quantity extras reuse that exact accepted Jade size and do not create new logical growth attempts; repeated actual Battlecries/Deathrattles create separate fresh attempts. This follows existing quantity material policy and is explicitly local pending CN confirmation; no authoritative current constructed Jade/Khadgar interaction was obtained.

All existing native Jade producers supply their actual SummonCause; legacy unattributed requests preserve the old path when unambiguous and explicitly reject active quantity sources. No invented physical source entities, second growth ledger, subset pool or new artwork IDs.
